title: APEC summit: AI and tech competition between US and China
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is welcoming US President Donald Trump and Russia’s Vladimir Putin on Thursday for the first-ever three-way summit between the leaders. contentText: Chinese President Xi Jinping is welcoming US President Donald Trump and Russia’s Vladimir Putin on Thursday for the first-ever three-way summit between the leaders. Beyond the wars in Ukraine and Iran, artificial intelligence and emerging technologies are expected to feature in the talks between Washington and Beijing, as the two powers compete for the lead in AI, advanced chips and other strategic technologies.
